run_mini_cheetah_simulation: run the pybullet mini cheetah robot simulation in GUI mode with position-controlled joints
load_urdf_robot: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulation at a specified starting position
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control to position control mode with a specified force for each joint
change_visual_shape_color: change the visual shape RGBA color of the robot base and all joints to white
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation forward in a loop with a fixed time step of 1/240 seconds
